note: US Army Corps of Engineers campground on Lake Ashtabula near Baldhill Dam, about 10 miles north of Valley City. The wooded loops sit back from the shore beside the day-use area with its swim beach, boat ramp and visitor center. --Claude
summary: rec.gov 233550 read: $26 electric / $20 tent, 27 sites (20 electric 30 A RV sites + 7 tent), all 20 RV sites fit a 23-ft motorhome (shortest driveway 25 ft; RV equipment permitted on all), 14 nights in 30, same-day booking. Description's '15 of which offer electric' is outdated vs the catalog's 20. Season not derivable (rate season is not a campground season). Not waterfront stands; pin ok.
flags: FIT / EQUIPMENT: every electric site 01-20 permits RV and Trailer. Shortest fit: sites 05, 10 and 12 (25-ft driveway; 'Max Vehicle Length' 20 ft on all three, site 06's trailer limit 25 ft). Under the ekko_length rule (driveway vs equipment MaxLength) all 20 take 23 ft; under the 'Max Vehicle Length' attribute sites 05, 10 and 12 read 20 ft. The other 17 sites run 36-75 ft. No fit concern for the campground.
SITES: the description says '27 campsites, 15 of which offer electric hookups'; the catalog has 20 electric sites. Count 27 agrees; electric-site figure in the description is stale.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. The catalog's site points put every RV site 150-250 m from Lake Ashtabula through continuous woods (sites 01-04 nearest, ~150 m); the tent sites 21-27 are south of the day-use area, farther still.

SEASON: not written. The calendar shows no inventory at all for November 2026 to April 2027 and opens May 1, 2027; closing date not readable (September 2027 not yet released). The May 1-September 30 rate season is not a campground season.
DISCOUNTS: rec.gov rules carry 'militaryDiscount' value 1 ('Military Discount'); not written (meaning unclear, likely the federal pass discount). Reviewer may decide.
